description: A pale, low-staining adhesive for mending, built mainly from cornflour, rice flour, or starch with a little wheaten flour and alum. The wheaten flour may be dropped entirely for the whitest sheets, since ordinary paste leaves unsightly marks on repairs.
name: white paste

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XX, p.280. Internet Archive.
